leadText:
Another Start (Korean: 또 다른 시작 Tto dareun sijak) is the ending theme for the Korean dub of Pokémon: Lucario and the Mystery of Mew. It is performed by Kim Jieun. 

The song was added when the movie was re-dubbed in 2013, replacing the Japanese ending theme song used in the previous dub.
